R4A-grouse-walk-0002.name: 150 m W of Salmo River
R4A-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4A-grouse-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Kapak Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: The Great Northern Rail Trail, 5.0 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
24 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Private land 40 m E: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Hwy 6 160 m W: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-8: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 65 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.33118, -117.24436, pull off on Kapak Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 140 m to the start. Walk: the The Great Northern Rail Trail stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 99 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-8, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-grouse-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-8: about 12,529 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 5.79 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
